name: Archer
strategyNote: Mass Skirmishers trade for free. If they're massing, add a Mangonel or dive them with Scouts/Eagles before they upgrade.

name: Crossbowman
strategyNote: Skirmishers + one Mangonel behind. Knights force them off gold; don't fight them with slow infantry in the open.

name: Arbalester
strategyNote: Elite Skirms + Onager shots on the clump, or Hussar/Eagle dives from two sides so they can't kite one way.

name: Skirmisher
strategyNote: Only hurts archers. Anything melee (Scouts, Men-at-Arms, Eagles) kills them for free — never shoot Skirms with archers.

name: Elite Skirmisher
strategyNote: Melee units beat them for free. If you're an archer civ, add siege or cavalry instead of trading arrows.

name: Spearman
strategyNote: Never charge cavalry in. Shoot them with Archers/Skirms or fight with your own infantry.

name: Pikeman
strategyNote: Bait them with cavalry, kill them with ranged units or swordsmen. Onagers erase pike masses.

name: Halberdier
strategyNote: Pure counter unit: kite with any ranged unit. Only engage with cavalry after they're thinned out.

name: Militia
strategyNote: A couple of Men-at-Arms or archers behind walls stop a Drush. Keep villagers together and garrison if needed.

name: Man-at-Arms
strategyNote: Archers kite them to death; towers and TC fire blunt the rush. Don't meet them with Skirmishers.

name: Long Swordsman
strategyNote: Kite with Crossbows or Cav Archers; they're slow — raid their eco elsewhere while they walk.

name: Two-Handed Swordsman
strategyNote: Hand Cannoneers or massed Arbalesters shred them; Onagers punish the clump. Avoid prolonged melee.

name: Champion
strategyNote: Hand Cannoneers + a meat shield, or Cav Archers kiting. Never let them reach your Skirms/siege.

name: Scout Cavalry
strategyNote: Spears + TC fire stop the rush. Wall your resources; a few Skirms die to Scouts, so use spears.

name: Light Cavalry
strategyNote: Pikemen at your eco, Camels if you have them. They hunt Monks and siege — screen yours.

name: Hussar
strategyNote: Halberdiers hold the line cheaply; add Camels or your own heavy cavalry to actually kill the mass.

name: Knight
strategyNote: Pikes in front, Monks or Camels behind. Wall your eco — Knights win by raiding, not by fighting Pikes.

name: Cavalier
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks, or mass Camels. Keep your archers behind the spear wall at all times.

name: Paladin
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks is the gold-efficient answer; Heavy Camels trade well. Never fight them in the open with archers alone.

name: Camel Rider
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry only. Beat them with Pikemen, archers or infantry — never with your Knights.

name: Heavy Camel Rider
strategyNote: Keep your cavalry away; kill Camels with Halbs, archers or Champions. They melt to arrows.

name: Monk
strategyNote: Spread units, keep Light Cav/Eagles to snipe Monks, or shoot them first — every conversion is a double loss.

name: Eagle Scout
strategyNote: Early Eagle raids: a few Men-at-Arms or spears at each eco spot; wall early.

name: Eagle Warrior
strategyNote: Swordsmen crush Eagles. Avoid archer-only armies — Eagles are built to eat them and your siege.

name: Elite Eagle Warrior
strategyNote: Champions/Legionaries head-on; garrison siege when the swarm dives. Don't rely on arrows alone.

name: Hand Cannoneer
strategyNote: Anti-infantry: charge with Knights/Hussars (they're inaccurate vs fast units) or outrange with Arbalest + Onager.

name: Cavalry Archer
strategyNote: Skirmishers + Camels/Hussars to run them down. Fight near your base so they can't kite forever.

name: Bombard Cannon
strategyNote: Fast cavalry snipes it in two hits. Never park siege or massed archers in its range.

name: Siege Ram
strategyNote: Melee units (even villagers) chop Rams fast; Mangonels help. Arrows are useless — never defend with archers only.

name: Onager
strategyNote: Split your army before engaging; snipe it with cavalry. One good shot erases a Skirm/archer mass.

name: Heavy Scorpion
strategyNote: Same: cavalry from two sides or your own Onagers. Never walk infantry into the firing line.

name: Imperial Skirmisher
strategyNote: Same rule as all Skirms: run them down with cavalry or infantry, never with ranged units.

name: Genitour
strategyNote: Mounted Skirm: only hurts archers. Melee cavalry or infantry deal with it easily.

name: Condottiero
strategyNote: Anti-gunpowder: if you're going Hand Cannoneers, switch — archers and cavalry handle them.

name: Missionary
strategyNote: Mobile Monk: same answer — Light Cavalry snipes; don't clump expensive units near it.

name: Flemish Militia
strategyNote: One-time eco army: whittle it with archers/HC and raid — they can't remake villagers.

name: Houfnice
strategyNote: Upgraded Bombard: snipe it with fast cavalry raids before the push arrives.

name: Imperial Camel Rider
strategyNote: Ultimate anti-cavalry: switch off Knights entirely — go archers + Halbs or infantry.

name: Chu Ko Nu
strategyNote: Melts infantry up close: Onagers + Skirms from range, or cavalry dive with armor upgrades.

name: Leitis
strategyNote: Ignores armor in melee — your Paladins/Teutonic Knights lose value. Halbs, Monks and ranged mass instead.

name: Longbowman
strategyNote: Outranges everything on foot: close the distance with Knights/Sicilian-style cavalry or Onagers; Skirms need siege support.

name: Throwing Axeman
strategyNote: Ranged infantry: cavalry closes the gap fast; archers outrange them.

name: Huskarl
strategyNote: Anti-archer: stop shooting it. Champions, Jaguars, Cataphracts or cavalry in melee.

name: War Elephant
strategyNote: Extremely slow: mass Halbs + Monks converts or kills the investment. Raid their eco — they can't defend it.

name: Jaguar Warrior
strategyNote: Anti-infantry: never send Champions/Eagles in. Archers and cavalry beat them cleanly.

name: Cataphract
strategyNote: Anti-infantry cavalry: Pikes are NOT the answer. Mass Camels, Monks, or ranged units + siege.

name: Samurai
strategyNote: Anti-unique: keep your unique unit home; fight with generic Knights/archers instead.

name: Mangudai
strategyNote: Kill them before mass: Camels + Hussars chasing, Elite Skirms holding. A slow deathball loses the map.

name: Conquistador
strategyNote: Mounted gunpowder: Skirms do poorly — use Camels/Knights to close, Onagers on the clump.

name: Plumed Archer
strategyNote: Fast archer: Elite Skirms still counter; add Hussars to chase. Don't chase with Champions.

name: Tarkan
strategyNote: Building raider. Castle drops and walls suffer — keep Halbs/Camels near your base and repair.

name: Berserk
strategyNote: Self-healing infantry: burst them down with Hand Cannoneers/Jaguars; don't trade slowly.

name: Janissary
strategyNote: Outranges Skirms: dive with cavalry in two prongs, or trade with massed Arbalesters + siege.

name: Kamayuk
strategyNote: Extra range beats cavalry hard — fight them with Arbalesters/Hand Cannoneers, not with Knights.

name: Slinger
strategyNote: Anti-infantry ranged: cavalry or Eagles dive them; never walk swordsmen in.

name: Ballista Elephant
strategyNote: Cuts through lines: Halberdiers + Monks (it's still an elephant); avoid tight formations.

name: Shotel Warrior
strategyNote: Fast shock infantry: TC fire + archers behind walls; they die fast to everything if you don't get surprised.

name: Mameluke
strategyNote: Ranged camel: archers + Halbs (they still counter cavalry). Onager shots hurt the expensive mass badly.

name: Gbeto
strategyNote: Ranged infantry, fragile: cavalry dives kill them; don't trade with slow melee.

name: Teutonic Knight
strategyNote: Melee death, but crawls: kite forever with any ranged unit; never ever melee it.

name: War Wagon
strategyNote: Tanky CA: mass Halbs + Onagers, or Camels diving. Small archer numbers bounce off it.

name: Genoese Crossbowman
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry archer: stop making Knights; Skirms + Onagers or infantry win.

name: Magyar Huszar
strategyNote: Treat as Hussar: Halbs + Camels. Don't waste gold units chasing a trash raid unit.

name: Boyar
strategyNote: Melee armor tank: arrows do little. Halberdiers and Monks, or mass Camels — don't melee with Knights.

name: Woad Raider
strategyNote: Fastest infantry — it catches your archers: screen with cavalry or meet it with your own swordsmen.

name: Arambai
strategyNote: Deadly but inaccurate: spread out, rush them with Hussars/Eagles — never clump Skirms.

name: Organ Gun
strategyNote: Shreds clumped infantry: send cavalry from the flanks; Bombard Cannons outrange it.

name: Rattan Archer
strategyNote: Ignores Skirmishers (high pierce armor): use Onagers, cavalry or infantry instead.

name: Camel Archer
strategyNote: Counters other CA; against you: Skirms + Camels, and close the distance with buildings/walls.

name: Obuch
strategyNote: Strips armor: keep expensive melee units away; shoot it down with archers/HC.

name: Hussite Wagon
strategyNote: Mobile wall: get behind it with cavalry or Rams; melee it down — arrows are wasted.

name: Coustillier
strategyNote: Charge attack hits once, then it's a weak Knight. Absorb the charge with Halbs/tanky units, then swarm.

name: Serjeant
strategyNote: Tanky but slow: kite with archers; ignore the Donjons and raid elsewhere.

name: Konnik
strategyNote: Kills twice (dismounts to infantry). Halbs + archers clean both forms; Onagers hit the dismounted clump.

name: Ratha
strategyNote: Switches melee/ranged: Camels + Elite Skirms cover both modes; Onager the mass.

name: Kipchak
strategyNote: Cheap CA spam: Elite Skirms trade great; Hussars force them off. Don't chase with slow units.

name: Urumi Swordsman
strategyNote: Splash melee: never clump infantry into it; Hand Cannoneers and Cav Archers kite it.

name: Monaspa
strategyNote: Stronger in groups — never fight the ball head-on with cavalry. Halbs + Onagers break the mass.

name: Chakram Thrower
strategyNote: Ranged splash vs infantry: spread out, dive with cavalry, or outrange with Arbalests.

name: Ghulam
strategyNote: Pierces through lines: don't stack archers in files; use cavalry or your own infantry mass.

name: Karambit Warrior
strategyNote: Half-pop swarm: Onagers, Hand Cannoneers and Champions clear crowds; don't fight it with single-target gold units.

name: Centurion
strategyNote: Buffs nearby militia — kill the Centurions first with Camels/Halbs, then the infantry folds to archers.

name: Shrivamsha Rider
strategyNote: Dodges arrows — don't shoot it. Halberdiers, Camels and melee engagements shut it down.

name: Keshik
strategyNote: Generates gold in melee — refuse melee fights. Kite with archers, hold with Halbs.

name: Flaming Camel
strategyNote: Suicide anti-cavalry bomb: spread your Knights/Elephants, or screen with one line of cheap Hussars.

name: Composite Bowman
strategyNote: Armor-ignoring arrows: Skirms lose value — dive with cavalry or Onager the mass.

name: Savar
strategyNote: A better Paladin: same answer, more of it — Halbs + Monks + Camels, and snipe their eco.

name: Iron Pagoda
strategyNote: Very tanky cavalry: mass Halberdiers + Monks; avoid slow melee trades.

name: White Feather Guard
strategyNote: Shu infantry: standard anti-infantry play — Hand Cannoneers, archers, Cav Archers kiting.

name: Liao Dao
strategyNote: Anti-cavalry infantry: don't feed Knights; use archers + siege.

name: Tiger Cavalry
strategyNote: Anti-archer cavalry: keep a Halb/Camel screen in front of your ranged mass.

name: Xianbei Raider
strategyNote: Fast raider CA: wall + Skirms at home, Camels to chase. Don't defend with slow infantry.

name: Cao Cao
strategyNote: Hero unit leading Wei cavalry: focus-fire with massed Halbs/Camels; don't chase him with archers.

name: Fire Archer
strategyNote: Burns buildings from range: cavalry dives and Skirm mass; repair with villagers.

name: Jian Swordsman
strategyNote: Dueling infantry: kite with ranged units; Onager the mass.

name: Sun Jian
strategyNote: Hero unit: treat like a heavy Knight — spear wall + Monks, and punish the army behind him.

name: Scorpion
strategyNote: Flank with cavalry — scorpions can't turn fights. Onagers delete scorpion lines instantly.

name: Mangonel
strategyNote: Never clump ranged units. Dive it with Knights/Eagles; it's helpless in melee.

name: Trebuchet
strategyNote: Send fast cavalry the moment it unpacks; screen with your army. Your own Trebs/Bombards answer from range.

name: Camel Scout
strategyNote: Feudal camel that beats Scouts. Spearmen + TC fire handle it; don't fight it with your Scouts.

name: Battle Elephant
strategyNote: Halberdiers + Monks is the answer. Flaming Camels/Camels help. Never trade gold units head-on.
